nodes.name: ai-sdk.md
nodes.summary: Walkthrough for building a Vercel AI SDK tool-calling agent on Neon Functions against the Neon AI Gateway, covering neon.ts declaration, a streaming fetch handler, image generation with Object Storage persistence, and client-side streaming.

nodes.name: function-triggers.md
nodes.summary: Detailed Function Triggers reference for Neon Functions: supported trigger types (schedule, storage_object_created), neon.ts and CLI declaration, delivery payload shape, the parseTriggerDelivery/parseTrigger/parseTriggerInvocation helpers, local neon dev behavior, inheritance across branches, and trigger logs.

nodes.name: mastra-studio.md
nodes.summary: Guide to running a Mastra agent on Neon Functions against the Neon AI Gateway while shipping trace observability to a Mastra Studio (Mastra Cloud) project, including structured output and CLI project/token setup.

nodes.name: mcp.md
nodes.summary: Reference for hosting a Model Context Protocol server as a Neon Function using @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and @hono/mcp over streamable HTTP, plus two authentication options (Better Auth MCP OAuth plugin, or API key/session JWT) and testing guidance.

nodes.name: sentry.md
nodes.summary: Guide to wiring Sentry (@sentry/node) error, log, and trace monitoring into a Neon Function's long-lived Node process, including required env vars, request span setup, AI-agent tracing, and a template for other Node SDK integrations.

nodes.name: sse.md
nodes.summary: Reference for building server-sent-events endpoints on Neon Functions, from a minimal framework-free handler and a Hono version to cross-isolate broadcast, wire format, client usage, and caveats.
